description: Decode an SD-JWT or SD-JWT VC (RFC 9901 selective-disclosure JWT, the credential format of the EU Digital Identity Wallet and of agent payment mandates): split the issuer-signed JWT, the disclosures and the key-binding JWT; hash each disclosure and match it to the digest that references it; rebuild the claims a verifier ends up with; and check the key-binding hash, audience, nonce and time claims. Verifies the issuer signature when a public key is supplied (JWK, JWK Set or PEM) and the key-binding signature from the cnf claim. A plain JWT decoder shows only digests; use this to see what a credential actually discloses and whether it holds together. Never send a private key.

expected_audience.description: The audience the key-binding JWT must name, if you want it checked.

expected_nonce.description: The nonce the key-binding JWT must carry, if you want it checked.

issuer_key.description: The issuer public key as a JWK, JWK Set or PEM. Without it the token is decoded but not verified.

now.description: Verification time in Unix seconds, for exp, nbf and iat. Defaults to the current time.

token.description: The SD-JWT presentation: issuer-signed JWT, disclosures and optional key-binding JWT joined by "~", or its JSON serialisation.

name: sd_jwt_decode
title: Decode an SD-JWT credential
